description: This file contains documentation, architecture overview, plugin configuration details, and hook implementations related to CKEditor 5 integration within Drupal. It defines how CKEditor 5 plugins are managed, configured, and extended via hooks and annotations.

classes.name: CKEditor5PluginDefinition
classes.description: Represents the definition of a CKEditor 5 plugin, including its configuration and metadata.

methods.name: hook_ckeditor5_plugin_info_alter
methods.description: Alters the list of CKEditor 5 plugin definitions to add decorators and custom types.
